admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Quiet hours: decision log

The member asked for quiet hours from ten in the evening until seven in the morning, so that no reminders or check-in prompts arrive during that time. The steward considered the request on the fourth and approved it, effective from that evening.

The member may ask for different hours whenever they like. Any such request goes to the steward, and new hours take effect only after the steward approves them.

Current status: approved and in effect.
